item.title: Google Blocks Search for Schools That Ban AI Tools
item.description: Google now forces admins to enable Gemini AI tools in Classroom and will block Search for districts that ban AI, reshaping education tech policy.

item.title: Google Lets Schools Opt Out of AI, but Search Goes Dark
item.description: Google will default‑disable Gemini AI tools in education, forcing districts to choose between AI assistance and core Google Search functionality.

item.title: Google Lets Schools Turn Off AI, But Search Goes Dark
item.description: Google will default‑disable Gemini, Notebook LM and Gemini in Classroom for K‑12, forcing admins to enable AI or lose access to AI‑enhanced Search.

item.title: Judge Dismisses Google AI Overviews Traffic Lawsuits
item.description: A federal judge throws out Penske Media and Chegg's antitrust suits against Google's AI Overviews, citing no legal agreement for traffic in exchange for free content.

item.title: Google Expands Gemini Spark AI Assistant to Paid Users
item.description: Google rolls out its Gemini Spark agentic AI assistant to all Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers, integrating deep workflow automation across Workspace.
